name: GET_rest_timemanagement_absence_v1_instructionalTextsForEmployee
title: GET_rest_timemanagement_absence_v1_instructionalTextsForEmployeeSelfService
description: Gets localized instructional text assigned within the time profile object. This text is supposed to help the employee to correctly request an absence.

parameters.name: $at
parameters.description: The date for which the instructional text is requested. The date must be in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
